answers.core: It is not possible to modify the behavior of built-in nodes without modifying the engine code, so it couldn't be made as an add-on.
answers.workaround: Waiting until the next physics frame to use `get_overlapping_areas/bodies` works, but is not always desirable.

title: Add a `force_area_update()` method to Area2D/3D to immediately update colliding areas and bodies
